<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="23" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="325" y1="19" x2="325" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="17" x2="330" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="15" x2="335" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="13" x2="340" y2="22" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="18" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="22" x2="360" y2="25" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="368" y="14" width="18" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="370" y="16" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="386" y="17" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,65 20,73 28,81" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="44" y="78" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Location access</text>
    <circle cx="360" cy="73" r="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="73" x2="366" y2="73" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="67" x2="360" y2="79" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Illustration panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="116" width="330" height="292" rx="20" fill="#063336" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="30" y="112" width="330" height="292" rx="20" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="253" r="103" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="253" r="77" fill="#ADD993"/>
    
    <!-- map roads -->
    <line x1="74" y1="196" x2="126" y2="239" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="126" y1="239" x2="113" y2="321" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="267" y1="184" x2="239" y2="242" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="239" y1="242" x2="287" y2="304" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="116" y1="287" x2="270" y2="211" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="155" y1="171" x2="180" y2="335" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    
    <!-- map markers -->
    <circle cx="104" cy="204" r="7" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <circle cx="280" cy="276" r="7" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <circle cx="125" cy="316" r="6" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="265" cy="185" r="6" fill="#5DB329"/>
    
    <!-- central location pin -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="242" r="46" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="242" r="37" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polygon points="195,302 178,265 212,265" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="242" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="242" r="6" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="223" cy="198" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="219,198 222,201 228,194" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <!-- small food service marker -->
    <circle cx="87" cy="282" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="87" cy="282" r="7" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="87" y1="269" x2="87" y2="265" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="87" y1="299" x2="87" y2="295" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="74" y1="282" x2="70" y2="282" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="104" y1="282" x2="100" y2="282" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="449" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="24px" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Find food near you</text>
    <text x="195" y="484" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Allow location access to discover</text>
    <text x="195" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">nearby kitchens, fresh meals, and</text>
    <text x="195" y="532" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">services made for your neighborhood.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Permission details card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="561" width="330" height="1" fill="#E6EBF2"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="595" r="16" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="591" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="596" x2="53" y2="602" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="80" y="592" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">Your privacy matters</text>
    <text x="80" y="613" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Location is used only to personalize your experience.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Enable button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="646" width="330" height="60" rx="20" fill="#063336" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="30" y="642" width="330" height="60" rx="20" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="679" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">ENABLE LOCATION</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Secondary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="716" width="330" height="36" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D6D6D6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Not now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="145" y="774" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#E6EBF2"/>
    <rect x="145" y="774" width="34" height="5" rx="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="797" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#999999">STEP 1 OF 3</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="808" width="390" height="36" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="808" x2="390" y2="808" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,823 46,816 54,823 54,831 48,831 48,825 44,825 44,831 38,831" fill="#5DB329"/>
      <text x="46" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="9px" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="124" cy="822" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="129" y1="827" x2="134" y2="832" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="124" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="9px" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Search</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="186" y="816" width="17" height="13" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="190,829 188,834 195,829" fill="#999999"/>
      <text x="195" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="9px" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="276" cy="821" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polyline points="272,822 275,825 281,818" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="276" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="9px" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Orders</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="346" cy="820" r="4" fill="#999999"/>
      <ellipse cx="346" cy="830" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="346" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="9px" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
